gaps: The manual lists FCC ID 2AANZMODB and BT ID D042773 instead of 2AANZTTN, so the FCC link is a lead, not a confirmed match.
The manual gives 8 mph as the top speed in its specifications but 7 mph in its speed limits section, and 265 lbs versus 264 lbs for the maximum weight.
The manual does not say the motors are brushless or give their power.
method: The Hover-1 Titan operation manual (model HY-TTN, manufacturer DGL Group, Ltd.) and the FCC record for 2AANZTTN (grantee DGL Group LTD., product code TTN, described as HOVER-1 - TITAN HOVERBOARD) both identify this unit.

comps.spec: 36V lithium-ion battery, 4Ah. The manual's specifications list 'Battery Capacity: 4Ah (20 Cell)'. The manual says the battery is built into the Titan and says not to remove it.
Motors (plural) located within the wheels, operated by the control system. Motor type, count per wheel and power are not stated in this source.
Digital electronic gyroscopes and acceleration sensors that control balance and motion.
LED Light, listed as feature 7 in the features list. The Hover-1 app can change the LED lighting colors and sync the colors to music.
Built-in wireless Bluetooth speaker. Music streams from a paired phone or other device.

Charger and charging cable included in the package. Charger input AC 100V-240V, 50/60 Hz. The charger light is red while charging and green when full. Full charge takes up to 5 hours. Output voltage is not stated.

Green board that the iFixit guide calls the gyroscope/motherboard. The guide is titled 'Left Gyroscope Replacement' and step 1 says the left side is the side with the charge port. Step 4 unplugs the battery from it at the yellow connector. Its motor-control role is not stated.
comps.loc: left side, per the guide title and step 1

comps.spec: Yellow connector between the battery and the gyroscope/motherboard. The battery guide says to hold this connector to unplug the battery.
comps.loc: between the battery and the gyroscope/motherboard board

comps.spec: Charging port that takes a 3-pin charging cable. The manual says not to force the charger into the port.
Power button. One press turns the unit on or off. The features list places it on the bottom; the controls section says rear.
Four sensors under the foot mats. The manual does not state the sensor type.
